clip.prompt: Use the supplied image as the starting frame and strict visual reference for a 6-second, 16:9 silent animation. Animate the woman in her existing position in the portrait; preserve three identity anchors exactly: her facial structure and proportions, the distinctive shapes and spacing of her eyes/nose/mouth, and her hairline and hairstyle. Retain the reference’s clothing, visual style, lighting, colors, and background. One continuous shot with a single very slow, subtle camera push-in. Begin exactly on the supplied frame: she gently develops a small, natural smile without changing her facial identity; then her eyes glance slightly to one side and back, accompanied by only a tiny, relaxed head adjustment. Keep her shoulders calm and all movement understated, with no exaggerated expression. By second four, let her gaze settle toward its original direction and hold on her softly smiling face for the final two seconds. Maintain consistent facial geometry and natural anatomy throughout, including the first and last frames. Audio off. Negatives: identity drift, face reshaping, exaggerated grin, large head turns, wandering eyes, facial warping, unnatural blinking, body distortion, background changes, camera shake, cuts, added text, sound.
